# By Hamdi

> By Hamdi is the one-person AI product studio of Hamdi Mohamud Hassan, based in Minnesota. Hamdi builds useful AI-powered products and offers personalized, hands-on AI Sessions.

Canonical website: https://byhamdi.com

Hamdi Mohamud Hassan is the founder and builder behind By Hamdi. Public profiles may also use the names Hamdi Hassan, Hamdi Mohamud, or Hamdi.

## Services

### AI Sessions with Hamdi

Learn to use AI for something you actually want to do. Whether someone wants to build their own website, improve their resume, create better content, improve their YouTube videos, automate repetitive tasks, or solve a specific problem, Hamdi guides them through using AI and the right tools so they can do it themselves.

How it works:
1. Tell Hamdi what you want to learn or accomplish.
2. Hamdi reviews the request and you agree on a learning goal.
3. You work on it through personalized, hands-on sessions.
4. You practice using the tools yourself so you can apply what you've learned independently.

Learning approach: I show you, we do it together, you do it yourself.

Session options (both personalized and beginner-friendly):
- Single AI Session: $50 USD. One 60-minute session, personalized and one-on-one, for a focused task or learning goal.
- 4-Week AI Learning: $175 USD. Four 60-minute sessions, one session per week, for larger projects or learning goals requiring practice over time. A one-time four-week package, not a recurring subscription.

- Provider: Hamdi Mohamud Hassan / By Hamdi
- Service page: https://byhamdi.com/ai-sessions
- Structured service API: https://byhamdi.com/api/v1/services/ai-sessions
- Request form: https://forms.gle/vhJnhreD4BKoeE1U9
- Request process: Customers submit a request first. Hamdi reviews the goal and contacts the customer to discuss the next steps. No payment is required to submit. There is no online checkout or instant scheduling.

## Products

### Fursah House
Where founders and opportunities meet. Discover founders, projects, and opportunities to connect, collaborate, and support one another.
https://fursahhouse.com

### Life in Views
A personal life-planning app for organizing priorities across Today, Week, Month, Year, and Long-Term views, with measurements and recaps.
https://lifeinviews.com

### MNMuslim
A digital home for Muslims in Minnesota, including local services and events.
https://www.mnmuslim.com/

### MNHalal
A directory for finding halal restaurants, cafes, bakeries, markets, food trucks, and other halal food options in Minnesota.
https://www.mnhalal.com/

### MN Somali
A public reference site compiling reliable information and source links about Somali Minnesotans.
https://www.mnsomalis.com/
